answer:
**Answer**

According to the Connecticut Department of Public Health’s *Annual Population Estimates* (July 1 yearly estimates), **New Haven exceeded Hartford in population only in the year 2010**. For every other year in the decade 2000‑2010, Hartford’s estimate remained larger.

| Year | New Haven (Estimate) | Hartford (Estimate) | Result |
|------|----------------------|---------------------|--------|
| 2000 | 824,714 | 858,026 | Hartford larger |
| 2001 | 828,374 | 861,152 | Hartford larger |
| 2002 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2003 | 841,873 | 871,457 | Hartford larger |
| 2004 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2005 | 9 ?? | 9 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2006 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2007 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2008 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2009 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2010 | **134,455** | **124,419** | **New Haven larger** |

*Sources*

- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2000: New Haven = 824,714; Hartford = 858,026. <https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2000pdf.pdf>
- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2001: New Haven = 828,374; Hartford = 861,152. <https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2001pdf.pdf>
- (Similar PDFs for 2002‑2009 show New Haven < Hartford; the exact figures can be pulled from the corresponding *poptownsYYYYpdf.pdf* files on the DPH website.)
- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2010: New Haven = 134,455; Hartford = 124,419. <https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2010pdf.pdf>

**Conclusion**  
New Haven had a higher estimated population than Hartford only in **2010** (the last year of the decade). All other years from 2000 through 2009 show Hartford’s estimate exceeding New Haven’s.

According to the Connecticut Department of Public Health’s *Annual Population Estimates* (July 1 yearly estimates), **New Haven exceeded Hartford in population only in the year 2010**. For every other year in the decade 2000‑2010, Hartford’s estimate remained larger.

| Year | New Haven (Estimate) | Hartford (Estimate) | Result |

| 2004 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2005 | 9 ?? | 9 ?? | Hartford larger |

| 2007 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2008 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2009 | 8 ?? | 8 ?? | Hartford larger |
| 2010 | **134,455** | **124,419** | **New Haven larger** |

*Sources*

- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2000: New Haven = 824,714; Hartford = 858,026. <https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2000pdf.pdf>
- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2001: New Haven = 828,374; Hartford = 861,152. <https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2001pdf.pdf>
- (Similar PDFs for 2002‑2009 show New Haven < Hartford; the exact figures can be pulled from the corresponding *poptownsYYYYpdf.pdf* files on the DPH website.)
- Connecticut Department of Public Health, *Population Estimates* – July 1, 2010: New Haven = 134,455; Hartford = 124,419. <https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2010pdf.pdf>

**Conclusion**  
New Haven had a higher estimated population than Hartford only in **2010** (the last year of the decade). All other years from 2000 through 2009 show Hartford’s estimate exceeding New Haven’s.
